name: Beat Type
tagline: Kinetic-typography poster type on warm paper: condensed caps, italic serif, colour bands.

motion.direction: Beat-synced kinetic typography. Lines are 1–3 words, huge (140–230 px), mixed per line: condensed caps (`anton`) next to an italic serif (`serif`) word; a new line every 0.8–1.6 s on the stressed word, letters popping in, cut out. One-word punches ("STOP.", "TWELVE") at 220 px. `counter`s for numbers, a `stamp` on verdict words, `chips` for lists in the band colours (`ter` red, `gold` amber, `goldd` blue), `patternCard` with `"solid"` as a colour band behind a word. Whip camera moves on the big hits. No photo bleeds, no film strips, no lock/reveal, no long sentences.
